# telnyx_external_connection_civic_addresses (Data Source)

The civic addresses and locations of an external connection.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object whose items are listed.

### Optional

- `filter_country` (List of String) The country (or countries) to filter addresses by.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only
